parsed.notes:
Who You Are supplies required qualifications; What We Need otherwise describes responsibilities, except its two explicitly optional qualification bullets. What You Will Learn does not ask for existing skills.
Hardware verification and RTL/testbench debugging are treated literally as hardware practices, not mapped to Software Testing; the taxonomy lacks suitable entries.
The appetite-only verification-strategy item is optional. Functional safety verification and all three formal-verification items are also optional; the unmapped schema has no requirement field.
The three formal-verification items are offered as alternatives, but no taxonomy IDs exist for them, so no scored alternative group can be assigned.
Python and Bash are alternatives in the qualification. Their appearance in responsibilities does not establish a separate qualification requirement.
Managing CI pipelines is mapped to CI/CD; no additional CD experience is inferred.
The Staff title supports senior, but the explicit welcome to various experience levels and potentially different offer levels makes seniority ambiguous.
